en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped park or garden path lined with trees and bushes. In the center is a wooden pavilion or gazebo with a pointed roof and open sides. To the right stands a small octagonal or polygonal wooden building with a steep roof and a small finial on top. A simple wooden fence borders the path in the foreground. Printed German captions appear along the top, and a red imprint with the publisher and date is at the bottom.
